literal_source_claim_en: The probability of the union of rare events.
statement_blocker: The catalog gives only 'the probability of the union of rare events'. Sources distinguish multiple inequivalent Janson bounds for nonoccurrence and the lower tail of a structured dependent-indicator count. The catalog does not select a1, a2, the product refinement, the 1990 lower-tail form, a quadratic corollary, or a conjunction; it also omits the random-subset model, family/index representation, indicator definition, overlap convention, lambda/Delta/DeltaBar definitions, codomains, ordered binders, hypotheses, conclusion direction, and boundary cases. Selecting or complementing one formula at intake would invent or substitute mathematics.
